capabilities: Generate Socratic, MCQ, Feynman, and flashcard questions from a note via AI
Evaluate written answers and score multiple-choice responses
Schedule the next review after a session
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README offers donations via 'Buy Us a Coffee' and links a full demo at deepnotes.wiki rather than embedding it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to study or quiz yourself on note content; reading notes back is passive.

relations.evidence: Deep Notes requires one AI provider to generate and evaluate questions
Ollama (local/offline): Install Ollama and pull a model

summary: AI study plugin that turns any note into an active learning session with generated questions, answer evaluation, and review scheduling.
